title: Mobility Equipment Safety Bulletin — Auxiliary-Port Test for Patients on Home Oxygen Therapy
content:
# Auxiliary-Port Test on Controller Replacements — Mobility Equipment Safety Bulletin

**Bulletin.** An auxiliary-port test allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty joystick or controller replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair when the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record is rental active or payment cap reached: 2 units when its portable equipment is a portable oxygen concentrator (E1392), 1 unit when it is a liquid oxygen portable (E0434), and nothing for any other portable equipment or when there is no such oxygen record.

## Records read

The status of the patient's Home Oxygen Therapy record and the portable equipment code of its oxygen class. A Home Oxygen Therapy record in any other status counts as no such record.

| Home Oxygen Therapy record status | Portable equipment | Auxiliary-port test allowance |
|---|---|---|
| rental active or payment cap reached | portable oxygen concentrator (E1392) | 2 units |
| rental active or payment cap reached | liquid oxygen portable (E0434) | 1 unit |
| rental active or payment cap reached | any other, or none | none |
| any other status, or no record | — | none |

## Hypothetical case

A patient renting a Home Oxygen Therapy system with a portable oxygen concentrator, rental active, has a controller replaced under warranty: 2 units.
